description: This file defines the WorkerPoolImplementation class, which inherits from WPEFramework's Core::WorkerPool and ThreadPool::ICallback. It includes a nested Dispatcher class implementing ThreadPool::IDispatcher, and manages a worker pool with thread and queue configurations. The class provides constructors, destructor, and an Idle method, and manages a Dispatcher instance.

classes.name: WorkerPoolImplementation
classes.description: A class implementing a worker thread pool with a nested Dispatcher class for task dispatching, managing thread and queue configurations.

classes.name: Dispatcher
classes.description: A nested class within WorkerPoolImplementation that implements the IDispatcher interface for dispatching jobs to worker threads.
